name: Walk
instructions: Stand tall and begin walking at a brisk but comfortable pace.
Land with your foot under your body.
Aim for a continuous 20 to 60 minutes.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A simple walk that builds cardiovascular fitness and daily movement.
